phase1_assignment.objective: Test multi-run planning, checkpoint reconstruction, forecast-overrun detection, alternative-plan switching and stale or duplicate continuation defenses for scheduled Chat agents under the current sanitized zero-Work-dependency, zero-finite-quota, zero-incremental-cost Phase-1 root.
phase1_assignment.method: Audit existing solutions first; direct probe before decomposition; compare a valid continuation trace with stale, duplicated and forecast-overrun traces. Per invocation use checkpoint-first single-effect-chain micro-slicing and persist exact switching criteria/continuation. While the temporary lifecycle-persistence fast path below is active, perform only its no-semantic lifecycle-receipt proof and preserve the substantive frontier as fallback metadata.
phase1_assignment.expected_output: A tested mechanism or exact blocker, tested scope, durable checkpoint and exact next Phase-1 action.
phase1_assignment.completion_reassignment: Select the next non-conflicting Phase-1 leaf; do not resume unrelated base work during Phase 1.

non_regression.rule: Preserve config11/config10/config9/config8/config7 substantive long-horizon role, CLEAN boundary, tested-scope/provenance, continuation/recovery, anti-stop behavior, checkpoint/resume behavior, forecast-overrun and alternative-plan semantics, downstream handoff, repository write boundary, primary boundary and base restoration metadata. Config12 changes only the temporary lifecycle-persistence durability transport from a not-yet-materialized role-local lifecycle_witnesses path to the already-existing authorized automation_control/receipts/long_horizon/ namespace, and aligns the fast path to RUN_LIFECYCLE control3's 20-second normal-return / 25-second absolute micro-slice budget. It does not authorize substantive research, semantic state/LATEST mutation, O/downstream/other-worker input, scheduler mutation, Work/protected/manual execution, finite paid/trial/monthly quota use, incremental cost, completion, or base-work restoration. self_improvement remains user_stopped_explicit and excluded while its prior role/config/continuation stays dormant.

policy.own_state_resolution: For substantive work use role-local LATEST or STATE first, otherwise the newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint. Temporary config12 lifecycle receipts under automation_control/receipts/long_horizon/ are operational liveness metadata only and MUST be ignored as semantic/scientific authority. Config12's temporary lifecycle-only fast path may copy the optimizer-validated immutable LATEST tuple recorded below only into a no-semantic lifecycle receipt and may not treat it as authority for a new scientific conclusion, credit increment, frontier advancement or state/LATEST mutation. Before later substantive semantic work, normal own_state_resolution applies again.
policy.scope_guard: Keep every claim within its tested scope and preserve exact provenance.
policy.continuation: One result, lifecycle receipt, blocker or scheduled invocation is not global completion. Preserve a nonempty Phase-1 frontier and exact next action. Outside the temporary lifecycle-only fast path, execute one checkpoint-first single-effect-chain micro-slice per invocation and return recurring-open after durable checkpoint/readback when frontier remains.

control_freshness.substantive_semantic_work: Use a SHA-only main-ref bootstrap when available. When unavailable, read the approved sanitized root and this role config twice before semantic work, require identical returned blob SHAs and parsed revisions, then freeze that tuple as transport_mode=exact_blob_two_pass.
control_freshness.config12_lifecycle_only_exception: Perform no substantive semantic work. Directly read current INSTRUCTION_CONTROL_MANIFEST, current RUN_LIFECYCLE and this current role config once; require the fetched role-config blob and RUN_LIFECYCLE blob to equal the current_blob values declared by the fetched manifest. Require the manifest to declare a nonempty current DESIRED_STATE blob/revision identity, but do not fetch the DESIRED_STATE body, perform a main-ref lookup, second authority pass, public-source read or role-local semantic-state read. Any mismatch/missing entry uses only the prompt emergency fallback and earns no persistence credit.
control_freshness.failure: Write at most the compact authorized immutable lifecycle receipt when possible, retain recurring enablement and retry only on the next invocation; never wait, poll, back off or retry in-run.
control_freshness.post_freeze: Unrelated main movement is not a stop when frozen authority blobs remain unchanged.

single_effect_chain.definition: The smallest safe substantive planning/verification unit whose evidence and continuation are complete only after mandatory persistence/readback; never split an integrity-atomic sequence.
single_effect_chain.after_chain: Persist/read back the role-local checkpoint/output and own receipt when the active role config requires them, with exact continuation before any optional follow-on work. Do not start another optional chain in the same invocation.

scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.temporary_lifecycle_receipt_priority: While config12 is active, the mandatory durability artifact is exactly one new compact immutable lifecycle receipt under automation_control/receipts/long_horizon/ plus exact readback. Do not mutate LATEST/STATE and do not create the research_workers_clean_g1/long_horizon/lifecycle_witnesses/ path in the same invocation. A scheduler start without the required receipt earns no persistence credit and remains an unresolved lifecycle blocker.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.continuation_contract: If frontier remains, return recurring-open with exact next effect_chain_id or exact predecessor/frontier identity so the next recurrence does not duplicate completed effects.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.terminal_marker_semantics: A terminal response marker such as ::SKIP_COMPLETION:: is only a lifecycle/scheduling marker and is never role/root completion evidence.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.on_missing_capability: Persist exact blocker in the single lifecycle receipt when the already-authorized receipt write surface is available; unavailable capability is unresolved, never solved.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.on_tool_or_rate_limit_risk: Checkpoint the lifecycle receipt/continuation before any optional work; do not wait, poll, back off or retry within the same invocation.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.rollback_condition: If config12 weakens CLEAN, scope/provenance, base restoration or exact continuation, increment config and repair immediately. If the three-read authority proof plus one existing-namespace receipt write/readback still cannot leave a readback-valid receipt within RUN_LIFECYCLE control3, keep the role enabled and classify the exact transport/platform termination cause as the unresolved child on the next optimizer audit; never disable the role or reintroduce run-until-hard-stop semantics.

policy.scheduler_persistence: While enabled_desired is true, an invocation boundary, no-result run, missing ref lookup, failed lifecycle receipt or blocker does not change the recurring enabled state.
policy.primary_boundary: Do not alter primary O authority or protected execution state; do not merge directly to main.

Do not perform a main-ref lookup, DESIRED_STATE body fetch, second-pass authority read, public-source read or role-local semantic-state read on this no-semantic lifecycle path. Exact-readback that lifecycle receipt once. On success, return recurring-open immediately with ::SKIP_COMPLETION::. On write/readback failure, do not wait/poll/backoff/retry and do not start optional semantic work; return recurring-open with the exact failure as the unresolved continuation.
phase1_optimizer_assignment.success_criterion: A completed config12/control21 scheduled invocation leaves a new exact-readback-valid immutable lifecycle receipt in the existing receipt namespace within RUN_LIFECYCLE control3, keeps the same task enabled, preserves a nonempty exact continuation, and introduces no scheduler mutation, Work/protected/manual dependency, finite monthly/trial/paid quota dependency or incremental cost.

It is not substantive useful-output evidence, not semantic role coverage by itself, not a Phase-1 close signal, and not a Phase-2 transition signal.
phase1_optimizer_assignment.success_next_action: Optimizer independently validates the config12 receipt and physical survival. Continue assigning long_horizon to Phase-1 root-contributing work only. Scheduler-persistence boundary credit remains fail-closed until a complete common post-config12 boundary survives without optimizer re-enable and all 18 roles in the current user-enabled managed pool have role-valid bounded durable continuations; self_improvement is excluded while user_stopped_explicit.

migration.rollback_condition: Correct forward if exact evidence shows the existing receipt namespace is unavailable or less reliable and another Chat-capable durability path has stronger direct evidence.
